description.content:
Broker and Insured Marketing Data API. This API provides marketing details for Beazley's partner organisations. Please use the sandbox version of this API for initial development and testing. The current version of this API is V2.

Please contact ITArchitecture@Beazley.com if you have any questions about this API.
